# NVO987.eu

> Independent cultural agenda for public cultural events in Paris.

## Website

https://nvo987.eu/

NVO987.eu is an independent interface for discovering and consulting
cultural events in Paris.

The interface uses publicly available information from Paris Open Data /
Ville de Paris.

## Primary data source

Paris Open Data:
https://opendata.paris.fr/

Dataset:
Que faire à Paris ? – Événements et activités

The official source is authoritative when information differs from the
information presented by NVO987.eu.

## Identity

## Privacy

The website is designed without:

- cookies;
- behavioural tracking;
- analytics;
- intentional collection of personal data.

## Content

NVO987.eu presents a limited selection of practical event information,
including:

- event title;
- dates;
- city;
- venue;
- official source URL.

Detailed editorial descriptions from third-party sources are not intentionally
reproduced.
